verification_results.title: CORS Wildcard on Crawl Endpoint
verification_results.reasoning: The finding points to line 42 which is `statusText: response.statusText` - not a CORS header. The actual CORS reflection (lines 38, 61) does reflect any origin, but the crawl endpoint is a server-to-server webhook protected by HMAC signature verification (CRAWL_WEBHOOK_SECRET). CORS only governs browser cross-origin reads; it does not protect (or need to protect) backend webhook endpoints. The HMAC signature verification at webhook.ts:115-157 provides the real authentication. This is not a security issue.
